easy_fields.name: LongVid
easy_fields.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
easy_fields.description: LongVid is a large-scale dataset of real-world long videos, comprising 300,000 hours of videos and 2 billion words of textual annotations. It is designed to enrich existing long video training corpora and supports models in handling diverse long video scenarios.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper extensively details the data collection methodology for LongVid, specifying the raw data sources (Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, MiraData) and how existing captions were leveraged and processed to create the dataset.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper describes the generation of textual annotations and QA pairs, including leveraging existing high-quality captions, using LLMs for event extraction, and categorizing the types of QA tasks created for LongVid.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper clearly states the intended use cases for LongVid, which is to train MLLMs for long-context video understanding, and implicitly addresses limitations by highlighting the need for such a large-scale, high-quality dataset.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper details various preprocessing steps for LongVid, including duration-based sampling, filtering segments, constructing event labels, generating QA pairs, and refining captions using AI models as part of the multi-stage training strategy.
